setup: For a ratio of polynomials as \(n \to \infty\), divide top and bottom by the highest power, \(n^{2}\).

steps.say: The numerator becomes \([[a]] + [[b]]/n + [[c]]/n^{2}\) and the denominator \([[d]] + [[e]]/n + [[f]]/n^{2}\).
Every term with an \(n\) underneath tends to 0, so the ratio tends to \([[a]]/[[d]]\), the ratio of the leading coefficients.
